slides.texte_overlay:
The 5 Most Famous Laws
In The World:

1. Parkinson's Law

Work expands to fill the time
you give it. Set short deadlines.

2. Pareto's Law

20% of your actions bring
80% of your results.

3. Hofstadter's Law

It always takes longer than you
expect, even when you expect that.

4. Goodhart's Law

When a number becomes the goal,
it stops measuring what matters.

Don't assume malice when
